Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Stoneware Vases, 2-Piece Set, 5.2"H, White and Blue-Green
Materials: stoneware
With their unique asymmetrical design, these 2 ceramic vases will infuse your interior space with a fresh and clean feeling. Display them on their own as a home-accent piece, or fill them with artificial flowers or greenery. 4.46"D x 3.54"W x 5.2"H 100% stoneware Crafted of fine ceramic, these vases have a glossy glazed surface that adds an elegant touch to any color scheme and decor. Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
